stories.headline: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu V900 AI chip and a 20 GW compute target for 2032

key_facts.fact: Alibaba unveiled the Zhenwu V900 on September 22 at the Apsara Conference in Hangzhou; CEO Eddie Wu called it 'the most powerful AI chip in China today'.
key_facts.excerpt: Alibaba's Zhenwu V900, unveiled September 22 at the Apsara Conference in Hangzhou... CEO Eddie Wu called it "the most powerful AI chip in China today."

key_facts.fact: Stated specs: three times the performance of the M890 predecessor, 216 GB of HBM, 1.2 TB/s inter-chip bandwidth, FP8 and FP4 precision, and scaling to 500,000 chips per cluster — vendor-reported, not independently benchmarked.
key_facts.excerpt: three times the performance of its M890 predecessor, 216 GB of HBM memory, 1.2 TB/s inter-chip bandwidth, FP8 and FP4 precision, and scaling up to 500,000 chips per cluster... These are vendor-reported figures, not independently benchmarked

key_facts.fact: The chip, from Alibaba's semiconductor unit T-Head, is slated for mass production and commercial release in Q1 2027; the earlier M890, out since May 2026, has shipped over 560,000 units to more than 400 external customers.
key_facts.excerpt: The chip, developed by Alibaba's semiconductor subsidiary T-Head, is slated for mass production and commercial release in the first quarter of 2027... The M890, released in May 2026, has already shipped over 560,000 units to more than 400 external customers across 20 industries.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba paired the chip with a roadmap of 20 GW of global compute by 2032 and a plan to train a 5-trillion- to 10-trillion-parameter model.
key_facts.excerpt: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu says the company plans to train a 5T- to 10T-parameter AI model, as it lays out a sweeping push across AI models, chips, and data centers

key_facts.fact: Chinese GPU and AI chipmakers took 41% of the local AI accelerator server market in 2025, up from near zero in 2022, with Huawei at roughly 62% share and Alibaba around 5%.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese GPU and AI chipmakers captured 41% of the local AI accelerator server market in 2025, up from near-zero levels in 2022. Huawei dominates with roughly 62% market share; Alibaba sits at approximately 5%.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba shares rose on the announcement, which came days after memory maker CXMT said its latest chip platform was entering mass production.
key_facts.excerpt: Alibaba shares rose after it unveiled what it called China's most powerful chip ever... Its announcement came just days after memory chipmaker CXMT — which is fast winning domestic market share from global giants Samsung and SK Hynix — said its latest chip platform was entering mass production.

stories.headline: Boston Dynamics opens Atlas training center inside Hyundai's Georgia Metaplant

key_facts.fact: Boston Dynamics opened the Robotics Metaplant Application Center (RMAC) on September 21 at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America outside Savannah, Georgia.
key_facts.excerpt: BOSTON/SAVANNAH, Sept 21, 2026 – Boston Dynamics today announced the next chapter in its robotics and AI strategy with the launch of the Robotics Metaplant Application Center (RMAC) at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America (HMGMA).

key_facts.fact: Atlas robots are being trained on real automotive work — preparing logistics and sequencing of parts before placing them in assembly order — with component assembly targeted by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: The robots are being trained in real-world environments, such as preparing the logistics and sequencing of automotive parts before placing them in the correct order for assembly. By 2030, applications will extend to component assembly.

key_facts.fact: Operations move next year into a new building roughly ten times the current center's size, and Boston Dynamics plans to explore use cases beyond automotive in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Next year, operations will move into a new building in HMGMA that will expand the RMAC to approximately ten times its current size... Boston Dynamics also plans to begin exploring use cases in other industry sectors next year.

key_facts.fact: Hyundai has said it will deploy Atlas across its global network, beginning with 25,000 units at Hyundai Motor and Kia plants over the next few years.
key_facts.excerpt: Hyundai said it will deploy Atlas across its global network, beginning with 25,000 units at Hyundai Motor and Kia global plants over the next few years.

key_facts.fact: Chief product and technology officer Zack Jackowski framed the center as 'pioneering physical AI at enterprise scale' and said SoftBank's acquisition of the Robotics and AI Institute from Hyundai will not affect Atlas development.
key_facts.excerpt: "Together with Hyundai Motor Group, we are pioneering physical AI at enterprise scale," stated Zack Jackowski... Jackowski said SoftBank's acquisition of the Robotics and AI Institute (RAI) from Hyundai will have no effect on Atlas development.

stories.headline: Cognex buys Intel spinout RealSense for $500M in cash to enter robot perception

key_facts.fact: Cognex announced on September 22 a definitive agreement to acquire RealSense, a maker of depth-sensing cameras for robotic perception, for approximately $500 million in cash from its balance sheet.
key_facts.excerpt: NATICK, Mass. and CUPERTINO, Calif., Sept. 22, 2026... Cognex will acquire RealSense for approximately $500 million, financed entirely from existing cash and investments on its balance sheet.

key_facts.fact: On top of the price, Cognex will add a three-year $56.5 million cash retention program at target plus roughly $50 million in restricted stock units for RealSense employees, taking the package to about $600 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Cognex will acquire RealSense for approximately $500 million in cash... In addition, Cognex will provide a three-year cash retention program worth $56.5 million at target for RealSense employees... and grant them restricted stock units valued at approximately $50 million.

key_facts.fact: RealSense is expected to generate $80 million to $90 million of revenue in 2026, more than 50% growth over 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: RealSense is expected to generate revenue of $80 million to $90 million in 2026, representing more than 50% growth over the prior year.

key_facts.fact: RealSense was founded inside Intel in 2014 and spun out in July 2025 under CEO Nadav Orbach; the unit had been on the verge of closure during Pat Gelsinger's restructuring.
key_facts.excerpt: The company began in 2014 as a research initiative founded by Intel... In July 2025, as part of a restructuring process led by former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger, Intel spun out the unit. Orbach... was appointed CEO.

key_facts.fact: Cognex sizes the robotic perception market at about $600 million today, growing more than 25% a year to roughly $1.6 billion by 2030; the deal is expected to close in Q4 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: a robotic perception market estimated at $600 million today and expected to grow more than 25% annually to approximately $1.6 billion by 2030... The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026

key_facts.fact: Before closing, RealSense will spin out its facial authentication product line into an independent biometrics company.
key_facts.excerpt: Until closing, RealSense will also spin out its Facial Authentication product line into an independent biometrics-focused company.

stories.headline: Hisense-backed optical chipmaker Ligent raises $723M and pops 19% in Hong Kong debut

key_facts.fact: Shares of Chinese fiber-optic equipment maker Ligent Technologies jumped as much as 19.2% to HK$39.3 in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday, September 22.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Chinese fibre-optic communications equipment maker Ligent Technologies (9856) jumped as much as 19.2 percent to HK$39.3 a share in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: The stock closed up 4.6% on its first day, well off the intraday high.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Chinese fibre-optic communications equipment maker Ligent Technologies (9856) ended 4.6 percent higher in their Hong Kong debut on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: The IPO raised HK$5.67 billion (about $723 million), selling 172.01 million shares at HK$32.96 apiece for a market value of roughly HK$32.4 billion at the offer price.
key_facts.excerpt: after the company raised HK$5.67 billion with its share sale... Ligent sold 172.01 million shares in its base offering, giving it a market value of about HK$32.4 billion at the offer price

key_facts.fact: Ligent is controlled by Chinese conglomerate Hisense Group Holding and had originally targeted about $800 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Ligent, controlled by Chinese technology conglomerate Hisense Group Holding, is targeting to raise around $800 million in its IPO in the city.

key_facts.fact: The company plans to spend about 52.9% of net proceeds on R&D — mainly faster optical products and chips — and 25.1% on expanding production capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: The company said it plans to spend about 52.9 percent of the net proceeds on research and development, mainly for faster optical products and chips. It will use about 25.1 percent to expand production capacity.

key_facts.fact: In 2025 Ligent ranked 5th worldwide in optical transceiver revenue with a 4.0% market share and 3rd in China with 10.1%, and mass-produces 800G and 1.6T transceivers.
key_facts.excerpt: In 2025, among all specialized optical transceiver manufacturers globally, we ranked 5th in global revenue from optical transceivers with a market share of 4.0% and 3rd in revenue from optical transceivers sold in China with a market share of 10.1%.

stories.headline: Google pays a premium to fund nuclear uprates at Vogtle and Hatch, adding 96 MW

key_facts.fact: Georgia Power and Google announced on September 21 an agreement under which Google will support uprates at the Vogtle and Hatch nuclear plants, adding about 96 megawatts of capacity to the grid.
key_facts.excerpt: ATLANTA, Sept. 21, 2026... Google will support uprates on Georgia Power's owned portion of the nuclear units at Plants Vogtle and Hatch that will allow the facilities to add approximately 96 megawatts of new capacity to the electric grid to serve Georgia Power customers.

key_facts.fact: Google's subscription is projected to deliver roughly $900 million in benefits to Georgia Power customers over the life of the units.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's subscription is expected to enable approximately $900 million in projected benefits to customers over the life of the units.

key_facts.fact: The deal was filed Monday with the Georgia Public Service Commission (Dockets 44280 and 56002) and creates a new Nuclear Uprate (NU-1) tariff under which Google receives Zero-Emission Credits; it still needs PSC approval, including a new extended power uprate for Hatch 1 & 2.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement is included in filings (Docket 44280, Docket 56002) made today at the Georgia PSC. The filings also include a new Nuclear Uprate (NU-1) tariff structure as well as a request to approve a new extended power uprate (EPU) for Plant Hatch 1 & 2.

key_facts.fact: Georgia Power told regulators it expects the Google revenue to put 'downward pressure' on customer rates, and would also use federal and state tax credits plus a pending DOE loan guarantee to offset upgrade costs.
key_facts.excerpt: A letter from the electric company to the Georgia Public Service Commission said it expects the Google revenue to generate what the utility calls "downward pressure" on customers' rates... Georgia Power said it also would use federal and state tax credits and a pending loan guarantee from the U.S. Department of Energy to offset some of the upgrade costs.

key_facts.fact: Surging data center demand is driving the push to expand existing nuclear plants; Georgia Power is already expanding its grid at an unprecedented rate.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal comes as surging electricity demand from data centers and other large users is driving interest in expanding existing nuclear plants as a source of round-the-clock, carbon-free power.

stories.headline: Samsung C&T to put up to $100M into Kairos Power's reactor for Google

key_facts.fact: Kairos Power and Samsung C&T announced on September 21 a binding term sheet for a strategic investment and joint commercial deployment of Kairos' fluoride salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor technology.
key_facts.excerpt: ALAMEDA, Calif. — September 21, 2026 — Kairos Power and Samsung C&T Engineering & Construction Group ("Samsung C&T") today announced the signing of a binding term sheet for Samsung C&T to make a strategic investment in Kairos Power

key_facts.fact: Samsung C&T will provide up to $100 million in direct investment and in-kind engineering services, subject to regulatory approvals, to help deliver the Hermes 2 demonstration plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung C&T has agreed to provide up to $100 million through a combination of direct investment and in-kind engineering services, subject to regulatory approvals, to enable the successful delivery of the Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

key_facts.fact: Hermes 2 is a grid-connected 50 MWe reactor that broke ground in April 2026 and will supply power to the TVA grid under a multi-plant development agreement with Google.
key_facts.excerpt: Kairos Power broke ground in April 2026 on the Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, which will supply 50 MW of clean electricity to the TVA grid, under a multi-plant development agreement with Google.

key_facts.fact: The package includes a $70 million equity investment; Google signed Kairos in 2024 to supply roughly half a gigawatt of nuclear capacity by 2035 as AI data centers drive electricity demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung C&T agreed on September 21, 2026, to provide Kairos Power with up to $100 million in equity and in-kind engineering for a 50 megawatt demonstration reactor serving Google. The package includes a $70 million equity investment... Google signed Kairos in fall 2024 to supply roughly half a gigawatt of nuclear capacity by 2035

key_facts.fact: Samsung C&T has delivered 12 gigawatts across 10 nuclear units, including Barakah in the UAE and Uljin 5 and 6 in South Korea.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung C&T has delivered 12 gigawatts across 10 nuclear units, including the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant in the United Arab Emirates and Uljin Units 5 and 6 in South Korea.

stories.headline: Finland's Verda raises $189M, becoming Europe's newest AI-cloud unicorn

key_facts.fact: Helsinki-based Verda announced on September 22 that it raised $189 million (€163 million) in an oversubscribed Series B led by Emergence Capital, plus additional investment.
key_facts.excerpt: Helsinki, Finland — 10am EEST, Tuesday 22nd September | European technology company Verda today announced it has raised $189/€163M million in new funding to scale its full-stack AI cloud. The financing includes an oversubscribed Series B led by Emergence Capital

key_facts.fact: Investors include MUFG Innovation Partners, Supermicro, Varma Mutual Pension Insurance, Lifeline Ventures, 6 Degrees Capital, byFounders and Tesi, plus angels Ola Tørudbakken and Mark Saroufim.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors participating in the financing include MUFG Innovation Partners, Supermicro, Varma Mutual Pension Insurance Company, Lifeline Ventures, 6 Degrees Capital (6DC), byFounders, Tesi (Finnish Industry Investment Ltd), and a group of angel investors including Ola Tørudbakken and Mark Saroufim

key_facts.fact: The round makes Verda — formerly DataCrunch — Europe's latest unicorn, worth at least $1 billion, though it did not disclose an exact valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Verda, an AI cloud company headquartered in Helsinki and previously called DataCrunch... The company states that this funding round has made it the most recent unicorn in Europe; Verda is now worth at least $1 billion, although it has not provided an exact figure.

key_facts.fact: Verda reached $165 million in annualized revenue run rate in July and plans to multiply its compute capacity over the next year, with new offices in London and San Francisco.
key_facts.excerpt: The announcement comes after the company reached $165 million in annualized revenue run rate in July. Verda recently opened offices in London and San Francisco... plans to multiply its compute capacity over the next year.

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2020, Verda runs a full-stack AI cloud — physical data centers and hardware through platform and AI research — employs about 250 people and has raised over $450 million in total.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2020 in Helsinki, Verda is a full-stack AI cloud company that manages everything from physical data centers and hardware to the cloud platform and AI research... Verda employs around 250 people from over 40 nationalities and has raised over $450M in total funding
